cp -r $C/pure-bash-bible $W/pbb && cd $W/pbb && $SH build.sh && cat manuscript/Book.txt && md5sum manuscript/*.txt

export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=a GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=a@b GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=a GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=a@b; mkdir $W/r && cd $W/r && git init -q . && $SH -c '. $C/git/contrib/completion/git-prompt.sh; GIT_PS1_SHOWDIRTYSTATE=1 GIT_PS1_SHOWUNTRACKEDFILES=1 GIT_PS1_SHOWUPSTREAM=auto GIT_PS1_SHOWCOLORHINTS=1; __git_ps1 "[%s]"; echo; touch a; __git_ps1 "(%s)"; echo; git add a; git commit -qm x; __git_ps1 " %s"; echo; echo m >a; GIT_PS1_SHOWSTASHSTATE=1; __git_ps1 " %s"; echo; git checkout -q -b feat/x; __git_ps1 " %s"; echo'

export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; mkdir $W/r && cd $W/r && git init -q . && $SH -c '. $C/bash-completion/bash_completion; . $C/git/contrib/completion/git-completion.bash; set +o nounset; for l in "git ch" "git checkout ma" "git log --pre" "git config --g" "git remote " "git stash " "git commit --am"; do COMP_WORDS=($l); [[ $l == *" " ]] && COMP_WORDS+=(""); COMP_CWORD=$((${#COMP_WORDS[@]}-1)); COMP_LINE="$l"; COMP_POINT=${#l}; COMPREPLY=(); __git_wrap__git_main; echo "$l => ${COMPREPLY[*]}"; done'
